title: Wearable Edge AI Applications for Ecological Environments
summary: A wearable edge-AI case study classified diseased leaves with about 90% accuracy in the field, reported a device quality factor of 0.95 and localized a disease epicenter to about 0.5 m. Evidence is limited to the study’s targeted forest setting and does not establish sustained operational performance.
ai_technology: Wearable edge-AI algorithms classify diseased leaves and test hardware, latency and task performance in a forest field setting.
